items.title: The Agentic Leap: Analyzing Gemini 3.5 Flash and Google Antigravity
items.summary: The recent announcements from Google surrounding Gemini 3.5 Flash are not an incremental update to a large language model. To view them as such is a fundamental misreading of the strategic landscape. What we are witnessing is the deliberate assembly of a full-stack, enterprise-grade agentic computing platform. This is the materialization of the shift from passive, text-generating systems to active, goal-oriented agents capable of executing complex tasks in the real world. For those of us building the infrastructure for the Agent-as-a-Service (AaaS) ecosystem, this is both a validation and a significant inflection point.
